name: Kobb Eel-Catcher
source_profile: ● Kobb Eel-Catcher (CG) is a popular fisherman and informal leader among the outer marsh villages. Kobb secretly organizes resistance to Ulbrik's demands and hopes to establish an independent community beyond the court's reach.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 55 (source excerpt; may be partial)
